text_block_list.text:
Despite her efforts, Найс Нэйчер fails to
catch up
to Токай Тэйо in the Japanese
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Токай Тэйо expresses her motivation to
train even
harder for the next race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер sees this and admires her,
musing
that Токай Тэйо is truly worthy of
being in the
spotlight.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
